chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup, in Uzbekistan. It is France’s first time. They play Venezuela. Near the end, Sid Belhaj scores the seventh goal! France win seven three.

chapters.label: How he builds attacks
chapters.text: Belhaj plays at the back. This is how he builds attacks: he passes into the pivot’s feet. Then he moves into space, and gets it back. Shoot!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Slow motion. Pass it in. Now move away from your defender, while he watches the ball. Get it back, score!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: pass into the pivot’s feet, then move to get the ball back!
